_note: Archival assets used by production/render_video.py. Files go in assets/archival/<local_name>. Licence data was taken from the Commons file pages as reported by web search on 2026-10-17; the Commons pages themselves could not be opened from the build container (network policy), so re-check every licence and author field on the file page before publishing. 'status' records what was actually done.

archival.subject: Portrait of Jorge Eliécer Gaitán, 1936 (the year he served as mayor of Bogotá)
archival.creator: Unknown photographer; source credited as Revista Credencial Historia
archival.licence: Public domain in Colombia (PD-Colombia per the Commons page); Commons warns it may not be PD in some other countries. Colombian law requires crediting author and source when known.
archival.resolution: 330 x 417 px (low resolution; shown as a framed print, never upscaled to full frame without grain)
archival.identity_check: Used on the Spanish and English Wikipedia articles about Gaitán and on the 1946 Colombian presidential election article.
archival.status: URL verified to exist (imported server-side into the user's Magnific library). NOT in the build container: the network policy blocks upload.wikimedia.org and the Magnific CDN.

archival.subject: Marcha del Silencio, Bogotá, 7 February 1948
archival.creator: Unknown (Commons lists author and source as unknown)
archival.licence: Tagged CC BY-SA 4.0 on Commons, but with an unknown author and source that tag is doubtful. Treat as UNVERIFIED: use only after confirming provenance (e.g. against the Banrepcultural Sady González collection) or replace it.
archival.status: Not downloaded (host blocked). On-screen caption reads 'MARCHA DEL SILENCIO · BOGOTÁ, FEBRERO DE 1948' so the image is never presented as a different rally.

archival.subject: A tram burning in front of the Capitolio Nacional during the Bogotazo, 9 April 1948
archival.creator: Commons credits 'Santiago Martinez Delgado' as source (unconfirmed as photographer)
archival.licence: GFDL 1.2+ per the Commons page (uploaded 2008). GFDL requires the licence text or a link to accompany the work; credit in the TikTok caption plus the report.
archival.resolution: 391 x 244 px (very low resolution; framed print only)

candidates_not_used.note: 2132 x 2848 px portrait listed in the Commons category; licence and date unknown from search, so not used until checked. Would be the best hero image if its licence holds.
2023 upload captioned 'La Violencia (1925-1958)'; location/date of the scene not documented. Not used.
CC0 photo of his death mask at the Museo Nacional. Considered for the ending, left out for restraint.
Sady González's Bogotazo photographs (Biblioteca Luis Ángel Arango). Best-documented visual record of 9 April 1948, but rights are held by the collection: request permission before use.
